details: Diplomatic discussions between Iran and several Gulf nations have been postponed, leading to renewed uncertainty in the Middle East. This setback, coupled with Saudi Arabia's closure of a key pipeline and warnings about oil supply, has caused crude prices to surge above $100 per barrel. Markets are bracing for sustained energy-driven inflation.
title: Middle East Tensions Fuel Oil Price Hikes, Spark Market Volatility

details: Following its latest rate decision, the U.S. Federal Reserve's officials are indicating a strong likelihood of another interest-rate hike before year-end, driven by persistent inflation and elevated geopolitical uncertainty. Separately, the Bank of Japan has raised its policy rate by a quarter point to 1.25%, the highest since 1995. Higher borrowing costs from major central banks are expected to affect global risk sentiment.
title: Fed Signals Further Rate Hikes, Bank of Japan Increases Rates

details: The U.S. has sanctioned an Iranian crypto exchange due to alleged links to payments for passage through the Strait of Hormuz. Concurrently, Tehran is easing currency controls, giving exporters more flexibility to bring earnings back into the country, including through cryptocurrency, as it seeks alternative trade channels amidst international banking restrictions. This highlights the dual nature of crypto in international relations, used for both illicit activities and economic bypass.
title: US Sanctions Iranian Crypto Exchange as Iran Eases Currency Rules

details: The mid-2026 transitional deadlines for the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation are now in effect. This mandates that cryptocurrency exchanges formally register and adhere to stringent anti-money laundering and stablecoin reserve rules, effectively moving crypto from a shadow economy into a more regulated and supervised financial sector within the European Union.
title: EU MiCA Deadlines Force Crypto Exchanges into Supervised Sector
